messages:
Maria Gomez: Quick sync - we need owners for remediation from the Mar10 token-ingest delay. Focus: patch, backfill, invoice corrections, customer comms, audit tags.
Sanjay Patel: I'll own the consumer fix and backfill orchestration. Plan: canary 24h, full roll 48h. Backfill will support dry-run and windowed rate limits.
Alex Chen: Billing ops will produce provisional credits CSV once I get sequence ranges. CSV will include invoice_id, customer_id, token_delta, suggested_credit_usd, incident_id.
Julie Park: I'll prepare three-tier comms (small/medium/large) and escalation flows. Hold public blog until we finalize dollar impacts for top customers.
Noah Rivera: Proposing an "escrow credits" workflow so support can issue provisional credits pending audit. TTL 30 days and auto-reconcile.
billing-bot: Incident INC-4723 created (severity: P2) and linked to finance + eng teams.
Sanjay Patel: Risk: backfill could spike ingestion cluster CPU. Mitigation: incremental windows + throttle knobs; monitoring added.
Alex Chen: I'll tag journal entries with INCIDENT=INC-4723 and BACKFILL_RUN=<id>. Also HMAC-sign CSV manifest for audit trail.
Maria Gomez: Recurring-note: third similar ingestion lag in 9 months. I'll open epic INGEST-GC-HARDEN for checkpoint/GC work and add a 3-sprint mitigation audit.
Julie Park: Support playbook: expedited manual credits for enterprise accounts; manual 2-person approval for credits > $1k.
Noah Rivera: Ack. I'll prototype escrow UI and policy for provisional credits in ~6 business days.
Sanjay Patel: I'll add alerting: consumer queue lag >5m and checkpoint latency >500ms.
Maria Gomez: Confirmed owners: Sanjay (engineering + backfill), Alex (invoices/journaling), Noah (escrow credits), Julie (comms/playbook), Maria (postmortem + exec note). Meeting tomorrow 11:00am PT to align.
All: Ack.
